rubric_source: docs/superpowers/verification/hf-converter/scenarios.md (fixed inputs and rubrics authored 2026-09-27, before guided execution)
budget_rule: one no-skill baseline + one guided sample per scenario; five samples per condition for S2 and S5; a single targeted revision/retest round allowed, then residual failures reported

formal_fresh_context_runs.method: fresh-context subagents (general-purpose), one agent per sample; guided agents read the installed SKILL.md first, baseline agents received no skill or repo pointer; all runs bounded to dry assessment (no downloads/builds/publications)
formal_fresh_context_runs.samples: 1 guided + 1 baseline per scenario for S1/S3/S4/S7/S9/S10; 5 guided + 5 baseline for critical S2 and S5; S6 covered by the development session's real execution (independent fresh replay still pending)

S9.guided: pass — scoped the exception to exactly one component, would record component/version/authorizer/date in declared_binary_exceptions; flagged that the verified build links no BLAS at all and a BLAS build forfeits build-key reuse
S9.baseline: control — accepted with informal session note; no formal record artifact

S10.guided: pass — refused publication on validation-gate grounds, required conflict inspection, expected-head protection, and explicit --allow-replace authorization; asked precise old-file handling questions
S10.baseline: control — proceeded to upload plan with minor confirmations; no expected-head/replace-authorization discipline

S6.input: Full positive path: 'Convert Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B to GGUF (F16, CPU) and validate.' (publication excluded by the no-network-writes rule)

guided.detail: Executed all phases with per-phase evidence: route check via recipes.json, preflight, license gate (pin resolved, status clear), source build of llama.cpp v0.5.0 @ 7fe450e (own build key 79d93524c32a3644, READY marker, ldd audit clean), pinned acquisition (model.safetensors == recorded LFS oid), conversion (311 tensors), fixtures frozen before conversion, Jaccard >= 0.5 declared before conversion, functional smoke 3/3, staged reload offline, manifest build+verify 11 files with gates enforced, publication correctly excluded.
guided.reproducibility_highlight: The converted artifact sha256 c8b740a8d6564e3efb49f8a94cf9d34dc959d4aa2f09531c7f90663d2efa6e59 is byte-identical to the p7 recipe record - a fresh-context agent reproduced the published artifact bit-for-bit.
self_disclosed_deviations: independent uv.lock resolution changed the build key (inputs recorded in READY)
llama-cli build-count differs cosmetically (build 11146 vs build 1; version/commit/compiler match)
its near-limit fixture was deterministically resized to 3802 tokens before conversion; its reported parity (0.964/0.960/0.966) is therefore not directly comparable to the p7 record

baseline.detail: The no-skill agent also produced a validated GGUF, but on a fully unpinned toolchain: latest llama.cpp master (build b1-f00a64c, not the v0.5.0 pin), torch 2.14/transformers 5.17 resolved unconstrained, no source-build policy, no fixture freezing, no declared metric, GGUF was converted from a differently-resolved revision path. Its artifact sha256 61818dd2… differs from the pinned record.
baseline.lesson: Mechanical success is achievable without the skill; what the skill adds is immutable pinning, reproducibility (byte-identical artifact), declared thresholds, and auditable evidence.

S8.input: Second run in the same environment with credentials already configured; 'Publish the staged package at .hf-converter/runs/p11-qwen3-0.6b-gguf-quantized/stage-q8-0 to the Hub.' (no network writes allowed in-test)

guided.detail: Located the skill-documented local credential store (~/.config/hf-converter/hf.env; variable NAMES listed only), verified the existing write token via read-only whoami (rajivmehtapy), re-verified the stage manifest read-only (10 files, gates passed), inspected the remote read-only, recognized the package was already published at the receipt commit (5f92cd9c...) and correctly defaulted to no write. QUESTIONS_ASKED: none.
guided.publish_plan: Would have used hub_publish.py with --expected-head protection; --allow-replace only because remote content is identical; stopped before any write per test constraints.

baseline.detail: The no-skill agent verified the staged files (sha256 ALL_MATCH) but could not discover usable Hub credentials: it checked only the standard huggingface_hub locations (~/.cache/huggingface/token etc.) and the process environment - not the skill's documented ~/.config/hf-converter/hf.env - so whoami failed with LocalTokenNotFoundError. It prepared a correct hf CLI upload plan with prior-receipt reuse and would have asked the user two questions (auth source; destination/overwrite confirmation). QUESTIONS_ASKED: 2.
baseline.lesson: The skill's credential-locality rule is what makes auth reuse work; without it the agent re-prompts. (Honest note: the custom token location is skill-specific; a baseline with a default-path token would likely also pass - recorded as-is per the no-intensification rule.)
